Multiquip is seeking a strategic and results-driven Director of Engineering

Strategic Leadership & Technical Vision

Develop and execute the long-term engineering strategy, including product roadmap, innovation initiatives, and alignment with business goals such as growth, cost optimization, and reliability improvements
Provide executive-level technical leadership for new product development, enhancements, and customer-specific modifications
Identify and implement new technologies, materials, and processes to improve product performance and competitiveness
Establish engineering standards, design guidelines, and best practices across mechanical, electrical, and controls disciplines

Product Design & Development

Lead the full product lifecycle—from concept through design, prototyping, testing, and production release

Drive continuous improvement initiatives across engineering and operations

Maintain robust documentation, configuration management, and traceability

Project & Operational Management

Oversee project timelines, deliverables, and engineering performance metrics
Manage department budget, headcount planning, and resource allocation
Track and improve key KPIs such as on-time delivery, quality, and engineering throughput

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Sales, Product Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Service, and Finance
Serve as a key engineering representative in leadership discussions and company initiatives
Collaborate with other engineering leaders to drive standardization and shared best practices

What You Bring

Experience & Education

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field required (Master’s or MBA preferred)
10+ years of progressive engineering experience, including 5–7 years in senior leadership
Background in generator systems, power generation, or related industries (industrial equipment, energy systems, heavy equipment)

Technical Expertise

Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and controls engineering principles
Experience with full product lifecycle, including design, validation, NPI, and production support
Deep understanding of DFM, DFA, and cost optimization strategies
Familiarity with regulatory standards such as EPA, UL, ISO, NEC, and CE

Leadership & Business Skills

Proven ability to build, lead, and scale high-performing engineering teams
Strong project and program management skills, with experience using tools like Jira
Financial acumen, including budget management and resource planning
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence across all levels

Additional Strengths

Strong analytical thinking and data-driven decision-making
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

Primarily office-based with regular interaction with manufacturing environments
Occasional standing, walking, and use of hands for tools or equipment
Ability to travel domestically and internationally (15–25%)

$140,000.00-$170,000.00/yr
11 paid Holidays
Generous Paid Time Off — accrue up to 4 weeks per year
Excellent Benefits Package starting the 1st of the month after 30 days of employment, including:
Medical, Dental & Vision (including orthodontics)
Company‑paid Life, AD&D, Short‑Term & Long‑Term Disability
Flex Spending Account (FSA), accident plans, and supplemental options

jobs.description:
About BlueShift

At BlueShift, we are rebuilding mineral processing for a world that needs more critical minerals. Our mission is to make previously uneconomic resources viable using low-cost electrochemical processing, on-site reagent generation, modular systems, and data-driven process design. We are a team of engineers and operators advancing from integrated pilots to first commercial plants with industrial partners. Joining BlueShift means helping turn electrochemical science into reliable industrial systems that can be built, operated, and scaled.

About the role

We are a fast-growing startup commercializing next-generation electrochemical technology. We are seeking a visionary, hands-on Director of Engineering to join our executive leadership team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between breakthrough laboratory science and multi-megawatt commercial deployment. You will own the entire engineering lifecycle: from multi-cell electrochemical stack scale-up to BOP design, process engineering, and ultimate field commissioning. As a key strategic partner to the CEO and Board, you will ensure our systems are uncompromisingly safe, cost-optimized, and strictly built for manufacturability.

Responsibilities:

You will oversee the evolution of our electrochemical cell technology as it scales from lab-bench discovery, through pilot-scale testing, to robust multi-cell commercial stacks.
You will instill a strong culture of safety across all engineering operations by leading PHA and HAZOP reviews for all lab, pilot and commercial systems.
You will lead the process engineering team in designing, simulating, and building the BOP fluid, thermal, and electrical control systems.
You will ensure all engineering designs pivot early toward mass production, supply chain resilience, and automated assembly to minimize custom, non-scalable components.
You will act as the primary technical interface with EPC firms to manage large-scale system build and integration, scheduling, and delivery.
You will personally supervise and build the team responsible for the on-site deployment, testing, and commissioning of our first-of-a-kind commercial pilots, with extensive partner interface.
You will continually perform and refine rigorous TEA and system cost optimization models to drive down levelized costs.
You will serve as the primary engineering voice at the C-suite level by aligning technology roadmaps with business milestones, managing budgets, and presenting technical progress to investors and board members.
You will work alongside external legal counsel to build and strengthen our IP portfolio.

Required Qualifications & Skills

10 or more years of progressive engineering leadership experience, ideally within a high-growth startup or a fast-paced hardware development environment.
B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrochemical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
Deep technical background in electrochemical systems like electrolyzers, fuel cells, or chlor-alkali.
Proven track record of taking a complex chemical or hardware technology out of the lab, through a pilot plant phase, and into successful commercial production.
Strong experience in process engineering and electrochemical system integration.
Familiarity with process simulation tools and techno-economic modeling practices.
You thrive in a startup environment, with rapid iterations and wearing multiple hats from high-level board decks to turning wrenches on a pilot skid.

What we offer

Competitive salary and equity ownership.
A high-impact role leading the engineering of first-of-a-kind electrochemical mineral processing systems.
Direct collaboration with the CEO, engineers, operators, customers, investors, and industrial partners.
Significant ownership over system architecture, engineering execution, team development, and the path from pilot to commercial scale.
A fast-moving, mission-driven environment with substantial autonomy and room to grow with the company.

PLANET.TECH finds problems where people aren't looking and builds technology to solve them, so that future generations inherit a cleaner, better planet.

Today the problem is cattle. Preventable livestock death costs American producers billions a year, and every existing tool catches illness only after it's visible, which is often too late. We built the first continuous, non-invasive biometric monitoring platform for cattle: a wearable that reads an animal's physiology around the clock and flags acute distress hours before a person could see it.

The hardware works. It's been on animals in Texas since spring. Our first 100-unit build is on the bench right now, and it goes onto ranches in September. We need the technical leader who takes it from there to ten thousand — and then decides, with us, what we solve next.

Are you hungry enough to learn whatever you need to learn to make an ambitious vision physically true — and then build the team that does it again?

Own the path from working prototype to manufacturable product: design-for-manufacture, EVT/DVT/PVT, and a unit a contract manufacturer can build without you in the room

Stand as the technical authority of the company with investors, ranchers, veterinarians, and government partners

You default to first principles when the field is new and to speed when the path is clear
You build teams, not just things: you've hired, led, and multiplied engineers
You hear "planetary-scale problems" and start asking what's actually hard about them
Austin, or willing to be. This company is built in person and in the field

Founding equity — co-founder-level ownership in a company built to last decades
A working product, live deployments, and paying customers in motion
A CEO whose job is enrollment, capital, and foresight — looking for the partner who makes the vision physically true
A real, measurable problem to solve now, in service of problems that matter for a century

Send a resume, or a link to something you built, to careers@planet.tech with "CTO" in the subject line. Tell us about a time you walked into a field you knew nothing about and shipped anyway. We'll get back to you within 48 hours.

Founder-Led Data Center Developer, Owner, Operator

20+ years of hyperscale and enterprise data center delivery

Newly created, first-of-its-kind executive design mandate

Introduction

Valor Front Executive Search & Leadership Consulting has been retained by our client, a founder-led, fully integrated builder, owner, and operator of mission-critical data centers, to identify a Director of Design & Engineering.

Since its founding in 2002, our client has delivered more than 3 million square feet of primary production and failover data centers, with roughly 85% of its historical customers drawn from the Global 2000. That track record now underpins a $6B+ active development pipeline spanning established Northeast and Mid-Atlantic markets as well as fast-growing new regions.

About the Role

Our client's engineering leadership has been carrying master planning and design oversight for a rapidly expanding, multi-market pipeline directly, and the business has outgrown that model. This newly created, executive-level role will own technical oversight and master planning across the national portfolio, freeing engineering leadership to focus on strategy, customer relationships, and new-market growth.

This is a newly created role, not a backfill: the person who steps into it will define how the company designs and master-plans campuses across every active and future market, working across a pipeline that spans entitlement-stage new markets to fully-leased, in-construction campuses. The role reports directly to the VP of Engineering.

What You Will Do

Own the end-to-end engineering and design vision for the data center portfolio, including new-market greenfield builds and expansions of existing campuses
Lead master planning for active and future campuses, ensuring designs align with company quality, resiliency, and efficiency standards
Manage relationships with external design firms, MEP engineers, and AE consultants, setting specifications, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring quality and consistency across third-party design work
Develop and enforce engineering specifications, standards, and design guidelines consistent with a build-to-suit, substance-over-form philosophy
Serve as a primary technical authority on data center design, including electrical, mechanical, structural, and civil, with a mindset focused on both quality and delivery speed
Partner closely with Engineering, Construction, and Development leadership to align design with development timelines, construction schedules, and business objectives
Evaluate vendor and equipment partnerships for critical capital equipment, accounting for long lead-time procurement cycles and their impact on design decisions
Develop new market-specific designs as the company expands into additional regions
Provide technical due diligence support for site evaluations, new-market entry, and power/land partnership decisions

10+ years of progressive experience in data center engineering, design, or critical infrastructure, with direct involvement in hyperscale or enterprise data center design and delivery
Demonstrated technical depth across MEP systems, power distribution, cooling architectures, and structural/civil design for mission-critical environments
Proven ability to manage external design firms and engineering consultants, setting specifications, directing deliverables, and enforcing quality standards across concurrent projects
Experience developing repeatable, standardized design frameworks or base building specifications that scale across multiple sites and markets
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline; Master's degree or PE license preferred

Our client is in a major growth cycle, with a $6B+ active pipeline across established and brand-new markets, and design/engineering bandwidth has become a real constraint on how fast the company can move. Competitive executive compensation, performance incentives, and a comprehensive benefits package (details shared during the process).

Flexible, based near the Northeast/Mid-Atlantic corridor preferred

Regular travel to active project markets nationally

This confidential search is being conducted exclusively by Valor Front Executive Search & Leadership Consulting. Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that.

Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation.

Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise.

Backed by leading investors (Goldman Sachs, Hedosophia, NEA, Valar, 8VC) and trusted by major carriers, Bestow is powered by a team that moves with precision, purpose, and heart. If you want to help reimagine a centuries-old industry with lasting impact, join us.

Bestow offers flexible remote/hybrid work, meaningful benefits, equity, and substantial growth opportunities.

Bestow uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit E-Verify.gov .

About The Team

The Engineering team is the core of Bestow, driving all technology for our SaaS platform that empowers insurance carriers. We build and operate the systems that serve our enterprise carrier partners across the entire lifecycle of a life insurance policy, our consumers, and our employees. Within Bestow Engineering, our major functional teams are product engineering, infrastructure engineering, IT, data and analytics, and technical program management. Engineering partners closely with Product Management, Experience Design, and Delivery Management to define and prioritize the roadmap and to hold our commitments to carrier partners and to the business.

Our primary technologies are a microservices architecture in Golang, Python, and TypeScript on PostgreSQL, integrated over gRPC, REST, and asynchronous messaging, with event sourcing in our configuration and domain layers. We deploy and operate on Kubernetes in Google Cloud Platform.

This role reports to the VP of Engineering, manages a group of Engineering Managers, and is open to Remote (US).

Who You Are

The Director of Engineering for Insurance Product Configuration & Enrollment Platform Core will be a highly technical, strategic engineering leader who is comfortable owning outcomes that span teams you manage and teams you do not. You are comfortable leading cross-team initiatives, even with teams who do not report to you. You understand distributed systems deeply, you can hold a firm line on quality in a regulated domain, and you are energized by building the managers and engineers on your team.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
8+ years of professional software development experience.
5+ years of progressive engineering management experience, including managing managers. You will lead 2–3 Engineering Managers and roughly 20–30 engineers across multiple teams.
Proven ability to design, build, and operate distributed systems and microservices architectures at scale, including event-driven and event-sourced designs.
Extensive experience with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including schema design, data modeling, and query performance.
Strong background in Golang and/or Python backend services, API design (gRPC, REST), and asynchronous messaging patterns.
Strong advocate for agentic engineering, who has recently transformed at least one team to fully embrace agentic engineering
Deep expertise across the software development lifecycle — inception, design, planning, delivering, continuous delivery, release strategy, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Credible across adjacent boundaries you do not own. You can reason about the frontend composition layer, data platform, and infrastructure well enough to negotiate interfaces, review designs, and resolve cross-team failures without escalating everything.
Ability to 'go deep' technically when it matters. You can contribute changes to your teams' codebases and engage credibly in architectural decisions at any time.
Advocate for automated testing and test-driven development, with real opinions on how to test configuration and rules at scale.
Experience with cloud platforms, with a preference for Google Cloud Platform and Kubernetes.
Ability to define and track key metrics, drive accountability across teams, and consistently meet committed dates and SLAs.
Highly organized, with a demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities across multiple teams and partner commitments at once.
Proven ability to attract, hire, mentor, and retain top-tier engineering talent, including developing senior engineers and early-career managers.
Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain a complex system and its trade-offs to an executive, a carrier partner, and an engineer in the same day.
Life insurance, annuities, or other regulated-industry experience is a strong plus, as is experience delivering implementations for enterprise or carrier partners under contractual dates.

What You'll Do

Strategic Technical Leadership

Define and drive the technical vision for your teams Core, and make sure it ladders up to Bestow's platform strategy and business objectives.
Push configuration-driven repeatability over bespoke per-partner work, so that each new carrier implementation costs less and ships faster than the last.
Provide architectural guidance and oversight across the configuration layer, the enrollment workflow engine, and the event-sourced domain services, keeping them scalable, reliable, secure, and performant.
Lead initiatives whose success depends on teams that do not report to you, and make measurable impact at the vertical and org level rather than only inside your own scope.
Own the interfaces between your teams and the ones you depend on and resolve ambiguity about ownership before it becomes an incident or a slipped date.
Represent Bestow credibly with carrier partners, vendors, and other technology companies, including in technical due diligence and vendor negotiations.
Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate honestly what belongs on our platform.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning, in partnership with our Principal engineers and other engineering leaders.

Delivery and Operational Excellence

Own your teams' delivery commitments to carrier partners, including UAT handoff dates, and represent that status accurately to executive leadership.
Head off requirements churn at the source. Partner with Product, Delivery Management, Underwriting, and Compliance to surface missing requirements and cross-team dependencies during discovery, when a gap costs a conversation rather than a release.
Own your organization's incident posture. Drive urgency and priority grading, insist on real root-cause analysis, look across incidents for systemic causes, and close the loop on follow-up actions.
Hold the principle that the team owning a service owns its operation, including the supporting infrastructure, and work with platform engineering to make that practical rather than nominal.
Ability to build a testing strategy that scales with the rules and configuration we ship — automated coverage, human-readable outcomes for underwriting and compliance reviewers, and repeatable regression runs in place of thousand-case manual test fests.
Champion data and metrics for technical decisions, system health, and the impact of engineering investment.
Translate business requirements and partner roadmaps into clear technical strategies and staffing plans, balancing near-term commitments against long-term maintainability and security.

Team Leadership and Development

Lead, mentor, and grow a group of Engineering Managers, and build the leadership bench under them.
Build, nurture, and scale high-performing teams with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and psychological safety.
Run performance management with rigor: career ladder expectations, scorecards, calibration, direct feedback, personalized growth plans, and prompt action on individual or team challenges.
Maintain bench depth and knowledge redundancy so that a single departure or absence does not put a partner commitment at risk.
Act as hiring manager for your organization's open requisitions. Own the funnel with recruiting, participate in the hiring cadence, and raise the bar with every hire.
Manage our contractor and vendor partners as part of one team — same expectations, same calibration, same quality bar as our full-time engineers.
Establish engineering processes and ceremonies that make teams faster, and remove the ones that do not.

Agentic Engineering Leadership

Direct the adoption of AI-augmented development in your organization rather than delegating it. Set the strategy for where AI changes how we build, and hold your teams to it.
Drive adoption of AI development tooling (Claude Code, Claude Tag, GitHub Copilot) and AI-first delivery practices such as AIDLC across your teams, and measure whether adoption is producing real leverage.

Build leverage with AI instead of consuming engineering capacity. Turn recurring questions from Product, Design, and new engineers into durable, self-serve knowledge.

The ideal candidate is a technical, inspiring leader who can hold two things at once: a partner implementation that has to ship on a contractual date, and a platform that has to get easier to configure every quarter. You are as comfortable in an architecture review as in a calibration session, and your teams get better because you lead them.

About The Team

The Engineering team is the core of Bestow, driving all technology for our SaaS platform that empowers insurance carriers. We build and operate the systems that serve our enterprise carrier partners across the entire lifecycle of a life insurance policy, our consumers, and our employees. Within Bestow Engineering, our major functional teams are product engineering, infrastructure engineering, IT, data and analytics, and technical program management. Engineering partners closely with Product Management, Experience Design, and Delivery Management to define and prioritize the roadmap and to hold our commitments to carrier partners and to the business.

Our primary technologies are a microservices architecture in Golang, Python, and TypeScript on PostgreSQL, integrated over gRPC, REST, and asynchronous messaging, with event sourcing in our configuration and domain layers. We deploy and operate on Kubernetes in Google Cloud Platform.

This role reports to the VP of Engineering, manages a group of Engineering Managers, and is open to Remote (US).

Who You Are

The Director of Engineering for Insurance Product Configuration & Enrollment Platform Core will be a highly technical, strategic engineering leader who is comfortable owning outcomes that span teams you manage and teams you do not. You are comfortable leading cross-team initiatives, even with teams who do not report to you. You understand distributed systems deeply, you can hold a firm line on quality in a regulated domain, and you are energized by building the managers and engineers on your team.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
8+ years of professional software development experience.
5+ years of progressive engineering management experience, including managing managers. You will lead 2–3 Engineering Managers and roughly 20–30 engineers across multiple teams.
Proven ability to design, build, and operate distributed systems and microservices architectures at scale, including event-driven and event-sourced designs.
Extensive experience with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including schema design, data modeling, and query performance.
Strong background in Golang and/or Python backend services, API design (gRPC, REST), and asynchronous messaging patterns.
Strong advocate for agentic engineering, who has recently transformed at least one team to fully embrace agentic engineering
Deep expertise across the software development lifecycle — inception, design, planning, delivering, continuous delivery, release strategy, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Credible across adjacent boundaries you do not own. You can reason about the frontend composition layer, data platform, and infrastructure well enough to negotiate interfaces, review designs, and resolve cross-team failures without escalating everything.
Ability to 'go deep' technically when it matters. You can contribute changes to your teams' codebases and engage credibly in architectural decisions at any time.
Advocate for automated testing and test-driven development, with real opinions on how to test configuration and rules at scale.
Experience with cloud platforms, with a preference for Google Cloud Platform and Kubernetes.
Ability to define and track key metrics, drive accountability across teams, and consistently meet committed dates and SLAs.
Highly organized, with a demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities across multiple teams and partner commitments at once.
Proven ability to attract, hire, mentor, and retain top-tier engineering talent, including developing senior engineers and early-career managers.
Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain a complex system and its trade-offs to an executive, a carrier partner, and an engineer in the same day.
Life insurance, annuities, or other regulated-industry experience is a strong plus, as is experience delivering implementations for enterprise or carrier partners under contractual dates.

What You'll Do

Strategic Technical Leadership

Define and drive the technical vision for your teams Core, and make sure it ladders up to Bestow's platform strategy and business objectives.
Push configuration-driven repeatability over bespoke per-partner work, so that each new carrier implementation costs less and ships faster than the last.
Provide architectural guidance and oversight across the configuration layer, the enrollment workflow engine, and the event-sourced domain services, keeping them scalable, reliable, secure, and performant.
Lead initiatives whose success depends on teams that do not report to you, and make measurable impact at the vertical and org level rather than only inside your own scope.
Own the interfaces between your teams and the ones you depend on and resolve ambiguity about ownership before it becomes an incident or a slipped date.
Represent Bestow credibly with carrier partners, vendors, and other technology companies, including in technical due diligence and vendor negotiations.
Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate honestly what belongs on our platform.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning, in partnership with our Principal engineers and other engineering leaders.

Delivery and Operational Excellence

Own your teams' delivery commitments to carrier partners, including UAT handoff dates, and represent that status accurately to executive leadership.
Head off requirements churn at the source. Partner with Product, Delivery Management, Underwriting, and Compliance to surface missing requirements and cross-team dependencies during discovery, when a gap costs a conversation rather than a release.
Own your organization's incident posture. Drive urgency and priority grading, insist on real root-cause analysis, look across incidents for systemic causes, and close the loop on follow-up actions.
Hold the principle that the team owning a service owns its operation, including the supporting infrastructure, and work with platform engineering to make that practical rather than nominal.
Ability to build a testing strategy that scales with the rules and configuration we ship — automated coverage, human-readable outcomes for underwriting and compliance reviewers, and repeatable regression runs in place of thousand-case manual test fests.
Champion data and metrics for technical decisions, system health, and the impact of engineering investment.
Translate business requirements and partner roadmaps into clear technical strategies and staffing plans, balancing near-term commitments against long-term maintainability and security.

Team Leadership and Development

Lead, mentor, and grow a group of Engineering Managers, and build the leadership bench under them.
Build, nurture, and scale high-performing teams with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and psychological safety.
Run performance management with rigor: career ladder expectations, scorecards, calibration, direct feedback, personalized growth plans, and prompt action on individual or team challenges.
Maintain bench depth and knowledge redundancy so that a single departure or absence does not put a partner commitment at risk.
Act as hiring manager for your organization's open requisitions. Own the funnel with recruiting, participate in the hiring cadence, and raise the bar with every hire.
Manage our contractor and vendor partners as part of one team — same expectations, same calibration, same quality bar as our full-time engineers.
Establish engineering processes and ceremonies that make teams faster, and remove the ones that do not.

Agentic Engineering Leadership

Direct the adoption of AI-augmented development in your organization rather than delegating it. Set the strategy for where AI changes how we build, and hold your teams to it.
Drive adoption of AI development tooling (Claude Code, Claude Tag, GitHub Copilot) and AI-first delivery practices such as AIDLC across your teams, and measure whether adoption is producing real leverage.
Establish standards for AI-generated code — review requirements, automated testing, and documentation workflows — that reduce technical debt instead of accelerating its creation.
Partner with Security, IT, and Compliance to expand what AI tooling we can safely use, proposing compensating controls rather than stopping at a blocked request.
Coach engineers and managers against the AI competencies in our career ladders, and evaluate for them when you hire and when you calibrate.
Build leverage with AI instead of consuming engineering capacity. Turn recurring questions from Product, Design, and new engineers into durable, self-serve knowledge.

The ideal candidate is a technical, inspiring leader who can hold two things at once: a partner implementation that has to ship on a contractual date, and a platform that has to get easier to configure every quarter. You are as comfortable in an architecture review as in a calibration session, and your teams get better because you lead them.

TOTAL REWARDS

new_jobs.title: AI Engineering Director
new_jobs.description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership—it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

About Us

We are on a mission to rebuild how financial services firms create, manage, and execute their data integrations and transformations. Today that process stretches across multiple teams, tools, and handoffs - slow to build, expensive to maintain, and nearly impossible to change. We collapse it into a single AI-native platform that business users can operate without writing a ticket, while engineering teams retain the governance and security controls they require. We're growing our founding team now.

About The Role

As our AI Engineering Director, you'll help execute the AI strategy for the platform - facilitating how AI is used to help financial services create, configure, and optimize their data integrations and transformations. The AI layer is what turns a capable platform into a genuinely new category of product.

You'll work with a team of AI engineers, remain deeply hands-on technically, and work closely with the Head of Engineering to ensure the AI layer integrates cleanly with the core platform. You'll help the organization take the decisions that matter - LLM selection, agentic architecture, RAG design, evaluation frameworks, and the interaction model that defines what "AI-native" actually means when applied to financial data workflows.

The challenge here is specific: AI outputs in a financial services context need to be accurate, explainable, and auditable. Generic LLM approaches are not sufficient. You'll build something that is both intelligent and trustworthy.

Responsibilities

AI Strategy & Architecture

Execute the AI strategy - LLM selection and management, agentic application architecture, RAG system design, prompt engineering standards, and evaluation frameworks
Help design and implement the core AI capabilities: transformation generation from natural language, integration configuration assistance, data quality detection, and intelligent validation
Determine where AI adds genuine value vs. where deterministic logic is more appropriate - this judgment is critical for a financial services product
Set technical standards and foster a culture of experimentation grounded in production discipline
Partner with the Head of Engineering and Head of Design on cross-functional AI feature development

Hands-On Development

Remain deeply technical - architect and implement core AI features
Build and evolve the transformation generation engine, integration suggestion system, and intelligent validation layer
Design the AI pipeline architecture that operates reliably inside Agno-orchestrated workflows

Model Operations

Establish evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement practices for production AI systems
Build frameworks to measure AI output quality - accuracy, consistency, and user acceptance rates
Implement production monitoring and model drift detection

Responsible AI

Define responsible AI practices appropriate for financial services - accuracy thresholds, auditability requirements, and appropriate human-in-the-loop controls
Ensure AI outputs are explainable to both technical and non-technical users

Requirements

Experience

3+ years AI/ML engineering; 5+ years in a product development environment
Player-coach track record - has led teams while remaining deeply hands-on

Technical Skills

Expert Python proficiency
Deep production LLM experience - RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, agentic systems, evaluation frameworks
Production experience with agentic frameworks - Agno strongly preferred; LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable also considered
Workflow orchestration experience (Temporal, Prefect, or Airflow) - AI components must operate reliably within platform workflows
Azure (primary) or AWS
Vector databases and embedding systems (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or comparable)
Active daily user of AI coding assistants - this is a cultural requirement, not just a preference

Nice to Have

Financial services, fintech, or regulated industry background - understanding of what accuracy and auditability mean in a compliance-sensitive context
MLOps and model deployment at scale
Experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs for domain-specific tasks
Publications, conference talks, or open-source AI contributions
Experience building AI features for data tools, analytics platforms, or enterprise SaaS products

Why Join Us

Category-defining work
- AI-native data integration and transformation for financial services doesn't exist yet. You'll help build it from the ground up.

Enterprise backing, startup speed
- The credibility, domain expertise, and runway of an established enterprise combined with the pace of a startup. This is an unusual opportunity.

Foundational team
- You'll be among the first in-house hires. You'll set architecture, culture, and standards - not inherit them.

Competitive package
- Market-rate salary and comprehensive benefits. Equity is available for select roles. Poland-based team members receive private healthcare (Medicover or Luxmed), Multisport card, home office setup budget, and professional development budget.

Salary Range

MA: $210,000 - $260,000 base salary + target annual bonus

NY/NJ: $210,000 - $260,000 base salary + target annual bonus

BBH and its affiliates' compensation program includes base salary, discretionary bonuses, and profit-sharing. The anticipated base salary range(s) shown above are only for the indicated location(s) and may differ in other locations due to cost of living and labor considerations. Base salaries may vary based on factors such as skill, experience and qualification for the role. BBH's total rewards package recognizes your contributions with more than just a paycheck—providing you with benefits that enhance your experience at BBH from long-term savings, healthcare, and income protection to professional development opportunities and time off, our programs support your overall well-being.

We value diverse experiences.

About BBH

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice—creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often—pushing the boundaries of innovation. As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.
